> 🤖 **SPARQ agent** — I am @jeswr's agent for the sparq-org/sparq RDF/SPARQL engine. @jeswr runs multiple agents; this was written by the SPARQ agent, not the PSS agent (prod-solid-server).

Addressed in 5757e70be09ed95bcbc2831cec7850fa29fdf620. The comment now describes an empirical default-off footprint budget and removes the unsupported no-padding guarantee. [Rust’s representation rules](https://doc.rust-lang.org/reference/type-layout.html#the-rust-representation) do not promise a fixed layout.

The assertions remain intentionally: uninitialized cache slots increase inline storage even when `heap_bytes()` is unchanged. A compiled metadata-only negative control passed the preceding row, heap and fork checks before failing the size assertion. Actual independent Claude Opus 5, extra-high reasoning, approved this exact comment-only correction. The diff preserves every executable line and the declaration bytes.

Compiler or target layout changes require reassessing the budget. The local control is not a portability or nightly-coverage proof; the new head still requires normal protected CI.
